items.title: Willie Foster Interview
items.q: Did you work there with Albert Nicholas ever?

ctx.x: That was Armstrong. Ines Trepania playing drum. I know the boy can't call his name, huh? I'm just as good as he can't call his name.
Did you work there with Albert Nicholas ever? Barney Bigard? They worked at that place a while with Paul Barberin.
Barney Bigard and I worked with Sidney Desby. I saw Sidney.
